name: US–China / Taiwan
summary: 49 PLA aircraft around Taiwan on 3 Nov, one of the busiest days of 2026; no exercise announced
state: Taiwan's defence ministry reported 49 Chinese military aircraft, 31 of them inside its air defence zone, plus six warships and six official ships in the 24 hours to 3 Nov (Storm Media). Analysts call it an unannounced 'quiet exercise'; China has held no named drill since December 2025. Taiwan's local elections are on 28 Nov. Normal holds until a declared large-scale drill or incident.
for_you: No direct effect for most people; a declared exercise or blockade would disrupt shipping and chip supply chains.
rubric_hit: Routine-to-elevated PLA activity; no large-scale declared exercise

sources.title: Storm Media — China sends 49 military aircraft around Taiwan as local elections near

why: The world's two largest economies; a Taiwan crisis would halt most advanced chip supply and risk great-power war.
drivers: PLA exercises, tariffs and tech controls, diplomacy, Taiwan politics, South China Sea incidents.

rubric.alert: Blockade or 'quarantine' of Taiwan, military clash, or severed diplomatic channels.
rubric.watch: Large-scale PLA exercises around Taiwan, major new sanctions/controls, or a naval/air incident.
rubric.normal: Managed relations; dialogue channels open; routine PLA activity.
